AC-6.reason: Exported schema and report contain all required fields, rationale, headings, and Phase 3 preconditions; tests bind report JSON to parseReading output. Number|null matches amendment.

AC-10.reason: Package-name import round-trips atomicWriteText; manifest tests assert runtime dependency/private version, and a real changeset-status test verifies fixed-group core bump with checkpoint unbumped.

packages/checkpoint/src/install.ts.message: On Windows, rename replaces settings.json with a temp file inheriting the parent DACL, dropping explicit ACLs. Secrets in its env block may become readable by directory principals.
Atomic rename replaces a symlinked settings file itself, leaving its target unchanged and breaking dotfile-manager links. Detect/reject symlinks or update their target.
Only some shell builtins are rejected. Commands such as `alias foo` or `cd dir` can be installed, then fail or change semantics under the no-shell spawn.

packages/checkpoint/src/sensor.ts.message: All inner stdout is buffered until exit. A verbose or non-terminating statusline grows memory without bound and never renders; stream output with backpressure instead.
A recording continues after the deadline; an older delayed invocation can finish after a newer one and overwrite reading.json with stale data.

packages/checkpoint/src/state.ts.message: Any string is accepted for `since`, so a corrupt non-ISO timestamp is treated as valid despite the state-file contract and can break timestamp-based consumers.
